name: xCodeEval
description: Recently, pre-trained large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive abilities in generating codes from natural language descriptions, repairing buggy codes, translating codes between languages, and retrieving relevant code segments. However, the evaluation of these models has often been performed in a scattered way on only one or two specific tasks, in a few languages, at a partial granularity (e.g., function) level, and in many cases without proper training data. Even more concerning is that in most cases the evaluation of generated codes has been done in terms of mere lexical overlap with a reference code rather than actual execution.
reputation: A multilingual code evaluation benchmark designed to assess LLMs more realistically via execution-based testing rather than lexical overlap.
notes: Execution-based benchmark covering multiple programming tasks and languages; results can vary substantially by language and task granularity.
